title: internet-elite-wrestling-cup-world-heavyweight-championship
label: CandyMan

won.source: Already billed as the reigning, undefeated World Heavyweight Champion by the 16 November 1998 broadcast; the tournament final itself, fought against Shawn Crimson sometime after the 26 October 1998 broadcast, does not survive in the held record.

note: Billed champion of record: the held record does not preserve the deciding match. Set to defend the title against Jack Vars at the promotion's own first supercard, "November Knockout" (29 November 1998), a date the held record does not reach.

title: internet-elite-wrestling-cup-americas-championship
label: James Miller

won.source: "Monday Night Elite" (16 November 1998): defeats James Pillow, then defeats an interfering Tony Paseno after blinding Pillow with a handful of powder and tricking him into striking Paseno with a chair.

note: The promotion's first Americas Heavyweight Champion, crowned on IEWC President Dusty Love's own in-ring announcement earlier the same broadcast.
